audit: MITM enumeration n<=24; independent immutable exact-weight layers n>24 at capacity<=4096. Check all queries, all integer observations, interval endpoints, work counters and partition splits.
cross: Integer endpoint recursion: floor intersection of endpoint affine lines, clamped to [left+1,right-1]; midpoint when slopes equal. Strict progress; same-packing endpoints certify affine optimality between.
dependencies: 67 objective scales,69 horizons,71 horizons share underlying draws. 72 capacity variants share items but change feasible sets. Counts are input records, not independent samples.
gatebb: Normalize every query; dense if normalized capacity<=4096, else exact B&B. Threshold fixed before all experiments, not timing-trained.
interpretation: Finite evaluations of known methods; no novel theorem, generic speedup, measured peak RSS, application validation or statistical significance claimed.
limits_note: Dense allocation and work, sparse states, B&B nodes and partitions reserved prospectively. Incomplete queries inactive. No production SCIP/PySCIPOpt benchmark.
proof74: Every positive-length real piece: original-problem endpoint proofs with and without a time-keyed checked optimal-bound cache plus independent feasibility/objective checks for each endpoint packing; VIPR valid and false-bound checks; explicit scope mutations. No presolve or formal verification claim.
small_tree: Retain prior terminal partition only if its size<=8; otherwise retain the incumbent alone. Decision charged within algorithm CPU.
ties: Maximize scaled objective, then side*slope, then smallest mask. At real-curve boundary the emitted packing is primary-optimal; it need not implement the oracle secondary convention at H.
timing: Three sequential rotated repeats on fixed subsets. Includes decisions, preprocessing, attempts and output selection; excludes JSON I/O and independent audit. Capped methods ineligible for aggregate speed comparisons.
